name: Inema Arts Center
subtitle: A privately run arts centre in Kigali (Kacyiru) showing contemporary African art, founded in 2012 by two self-taught painter brothers.

facts.label: Founded

parts.text: A privately run arts centre in Kigali (Kacyiru) showing contemporary African art, founded in 2012 by two self-taught painter brothers. It runs a gallery, courses and programmes for artists.
